description: Characterized arm of the reach instrument: the Thorn Marshal.
notes: The **treatment arm**: `reach_study` with a character in it, built to the shape ADR-008 established for `projectile_rain_boss` / `chancellor`.

It exists because that condition had exactly one instance, and one instance cannot separate 'characterization changes how a fight is played' from 'the Chancellor changes how that particular fight is played'. A second pair over a different question is the cheapest thing that can tell those apart.

Everything mechanical must match the control: same arena, same player start, same spawn position, same wave timing, and a boss spread from the control's object in `lab/config.ts`. Only `archetype` differs, and it is what carries silhouette, colour and name.

Written out rather than spread for the same reason the Chancellor's room is — the literal is what a reader compares. `tests/thorn-marshal.test.ts` asserts the two are identical field for field apart from the archetype.

Public since 2026-08-03 (ADR-038): the herald offers this room as an aside, `game/public-profile.ts` mirrors this encounter and his tuning field for field, and `cast/index-public.ts` ships his body. `reach_study` stays laboratory-only — the pair is a comparison only while the control does not travel — and ADR-005's gate stands over every claim the pair produces.
